graph.name: Global DataNet - Construction Site Image Obfuscation Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture ingests construction site images via SFTP to S3, processes them instantly and in batch using Lambda and Amazon Rekognition to blur sensitive data, and delivers results via S3.

nodes.name: Rekognition Custom Labels
nodes.notes: Custom trained model for construction workers

edges.notes: SFTP writes raw images to ingestion S3 bucket
S3 event triggers instant Lambda processing
Lambda invokes Rekognition for object/face detection
Processed image saved to platform S3 bucket
Batch Lambda runs custom label detection
Batch output saved to platform S3 bucket
Processed images served to web client platform
